delivery.title: Delivery & returns
delivery.intro: Everything you need to know about how your Lunelle order reaches you.

how.title: How an order works
how.p1: Place your order on the site: no account is needed.
how.p2: We call you within 24 hours to confirm it. Please keep your phone nearby and check that the number you entered is correct.
how.p3: If you want to change something (an item, the address or the delivery method), tell us during the confirmation call.

methods.title: Ways to receive your order
methods.p1: Hand-to-hand: free of charge, with no address needed. We agree on the meeting place and time with you by phone.
methods.p2: Home delivery: your order is delivered to your address. You choose your wilaya and commune and enter your address at checkout.
methods.p3: Yalidine office: you collect your order at the Yalidine office of the commune you choose. Only communes with an office are offered.

fees.title: Delivery fees
fees.p2: For home and office delivery, the fee depends on your wilaya and on the delivery method.
fees.p3: The exact fee and your total are shown at checkout before you confirm your order.

payment.title: Payment
payment.p1: You pay in cash, only when you receive your order: to the delivery person for home delivery, at the Yalidine office when you collect it, or at the meeting for hand-to-hand.
payment.p2: There is no online payment. The total to pay is the price of your products plus the delivery fee, if any.
payment.p3: We never ask for payment in advance.

times.title: Delivery times
times.p1: The delivery time depends on your wilaya and the delivery method.
times.p2: We tell you the estimated time when we call to confirm your order.

tracking.title: Following your order
tracking.p1: After you order, you get a private page that shows where your order is.
tracking.p2: You can also use “Track my order” at the bottom of any page, with your order number and the phone number you used.

unreachable.title: If we can't reach you
unreachable.p1: If we are unable to reach you by phone, we can't confirm your order, and it may be cancelled.

problems.title: Problems, returns and exchanges
problems.p1: Please check your parcel when you receive it.
problems.p2: If an item is damaged or isn't what you ordered, contact us as soon as possible with your order number: our phone number and social media are at the bottom of every page.
problems.p3: Our policy on returns and exchanges is being finalised and will be published here.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: This page explains what information we collect when you order from Lunelle, and how we use it.

collect.title: What we collect
collect.p2: Your delivery choice and destination: wilaya, commune and, for home delivery, your address.
collect.p3: The items you order, and any note you add.

use.title: How we use it
use.p1: To call you and confirm your order.
use.p2: To prepare and deliver your order.
use.p3: To let you follow your order.
use.p4: To contact you about your order if needed.

sharing.title: Who sees it
sharing.p1: Your information is used by the Lunelle team to handle your order, including through the private chat where we receive new orders.
sharing.p2: To deliver your order, the necessary details (your name, phone number and destination) are given to the delivery service, such as Yalidine.
sharing.p3: We do not sell your information, and we do not use it for advertising.

storage.title: Your browser
storage.p1: Your cart is saved in your browser so you don't lose it. It stays on your device.
storage.p2: We save your language choice in a cookie.
storage.p3: We don't use advertising or tracking cookies at the moment. If this changes, we will update this page.

keep.title: How long we keep it
keep.p1: We keep your order information for as long as needed to handle your order and to keep our records.

rights.title: Your choices
rights.p1: You can ask us to correct or delete your information, or ask what we hold about you.
rights.p2: Contact us by phone or on social media: our details are at the bottom of every page.

security.title: Security
security.p1: We take reasonable measures to protect your information, and only authorised people can access orders.

changes.title: Changes
changes.p1: We may update this page. The date at the top shows when it was last changed.

terms.title: Terms of sale
terms.intro: These terms apply to every order placed on this site.

about.title: About us
about.p1: This site is operated by Lunelle, a perfume brand.
about.p2: By placing an order, you agree to these terms.

orders.title: Orders
orders.p1: Placing an order is a request to buy. It is confirmed when we call you and agree the details together.
orders.p2: We may refuse or cancel an order, for example if an item is no longer available or if we cannot reach you.
orders.p3: You can ask for changes during the confirmation call.

prices.title: Prices
prices.p1: Prices are in Algerian dinars (DZD). Discounted products show the old and the new price.
prices.p2: Packs have a fixed price, shown on the pack page.
prices.p3: Delivery fees are shown separately at checkout. The price you see when you place your order is the price you pay.

availability.title: Availability
availability.p1: Our stock is limited. Products that are out of stock can't be ordered.
availability.p2: You can order up to 10 of the same item in one order.

payment.title: Payment
payment.p1: Payment is in cash on receipt of your order. See “Delivery & returns” for details.

delivery.title: Delivery
delivery.p1: Delivery methods, fees and times are described on the “Delivery & returns” page.

problems.title: Returns and exchanges
problems.p1: Our policy on returns and exchanges is being finalised. Meanwhile, if there is a problem with your order, contact us as soon as possible.

law.title: Applicable law
law.p1: These terms are governed by Algerian law.
